# depiction image

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:depictionImage`](gmeow-depictionImage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/depictionImage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The image ([`MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md)) that depicts the subject in a depiction usage. Functional per relator: one image per [`DepictionUsage`](../classes/gmeow-DepictionUsage.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:DepictionUsage`](../classes/gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:depictionImage`](gmeow-depictionImage.md) from [`gmeow:DepictionUsage`](../classes/gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) to [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Photo Metadata

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/images/examples/photo-metadata.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/images/examples/photo-metadata.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-images-examples-photo-metadata)#example-slices-extensions-images-examples-photo-metadata

```turtle
# --- The depiction as a perspectival act: who is depicted, in what context, by
#     whose authority — not a privileged "this is a photo of Dana" fact.
ex:depiction a gmeow:DepictionUsage ;
    gmeow:depictionImage     ex:photo ;
    gmeow:depictionSubject   ex:dana ;
    gmeow:depictionContext   gmeow:depictionContextCandid ;
    gmeow:depictionAuthority ex:photographer .
```
